calc.breakdown_hint: Every step of the engine, in order.
calc.cheaper_none: It cannot be made cheaper without losing protection.
calc.cheaper_offline: The server is unavailable: the engine computes these tips, open the screen through the application.
calc.checks_hint: Each one cites a legal provision.
calc.copy_failed: Copying failed — select the text and copy it by hand.
calc.doc_sending: Sending the document to the server…
calc.factor_empty_class: there are no products in this class
calc.factors_hint: The set depends on the class. An empty field means the factor is not counted.

calc.filled_nothing: Nothing from the document was filled into the form

calc.make_hint: in Latin letters, as on the marketplace: Chevrolet
calc.market_none: NAPP reports have no market rate for this class.
calc.measures: What to require from the policyholder
calc.mileage_hint: the registration certificate has no mileage — enter it from the odometer; the adjustment depends on it
calc.not_calibrated_note: Base rates ({rates} rows) and coefficients ({coefs} rows) are expert values until the company's own statistics are loaded.
calc.object_kind_hint: as in the cadastre: dwelling, non-residential building…
calc.perils_by_rules: in full under the policy conditions
calc.photo_done: Done. Confidence: {confidence}. Check the values that were filled in.
calc.photo_failed: These photos gave nothing — fill in the fields by hand.

calc.product_not_found: Nothing found. Try part of the name or the product code.
calc.recognised_fields: Fields recognised: {n}. Check every one: this is a reading of a photo, not the document.
calc.rooms_hint: the cadastre has no room count — take it from the floor plan or a measurement
calc.subtitle: Pick a product and fill in the fields. The rate and premium on the right recalculate at once — no need to press a calculate button.
calc.title: New calculation
calc.valuation_ads_note: The valuation was produced by the system from marketplace listings: it is not the marketplace's own text. The original listings and photos are on the source site.
calc.valuation_ads_skipped: Listings were found but were not used
calc.valuation_ads_stats: Listings with a price: {prices} (found in total {ads}), window {months} months.
calc.valuation_failed: the valuation could not be obtained
calc.valuation_failed_server: The value is computed on the server, not in the browser — try again later.
calc.valuation_initial_hint: what the object cost when new
calc.valuation_norms_expert: depreciation_norms reference, the norms are expert estimates
calc.valuation_norms_missing: the server did not return the norms reference
calc.valuation_norms_waiting: the server has not returned the list of norms yet
calc.valuation_wait: The server is polling the marketplaces, this takes a few seconds.
calc.valuation_wear_note: The calculation was produced by the system from the company's depreciation norms (straight-line method): it is not a company document.
calc.verdict_ok: All checks passed — it can be issued
calc.verdict_stop: Cannot be issued: there are breaches
calc.verdict_warn: May be issued, but the underwriter must decide
calc.vin_hint: identification number from the vehicle registration certificate
calc.year_built_hint: the cadastre has no year built — a balance holder's certificate is needed; wear is counted from this date
check.below_technical.ok.title: The rate covers the expected losses
check.below_technical.warn.detail: It is short by {gap} pp; the contract is loss-making — the underwriter decides.
check.below_technical.warn.title: The rate is below the technical rate
check.cat_accumulation.warn.detail: The sum insured adds to the zone accumulation; the zone limit must be controlled.
check.cat_accumulation.warn.title: Catastrophe risk in a seismic zone
check.credit_payer.stop.detail: The lending bank is the policyholder and the premium is accepted only from the bank.
check.credit_payer.stop.title: The policyholder or payer is not the bank
check.credit_uncovered.ok.title: The sum insured is within the uncovered part
check.credit_uncovered.stop.detail: No more than {cap} UZS is allowed: the uncovered part, and not above 50% of the loan.
check.credit_uncovered.stop.title: The sum insured is above what the loan allows
check.disclosure.warn.detail: Art. 63: the price, perils covered and excluded, refund of premium, claims procedure.
check.disclosure.warn.title: The client has not been given the disclosure
check.docs_missing.warn.title: Missing documents: {n}
check.docs_ok.ok.detail: The calculation can be passed to the contract.
check.docs_ok.ok.title: The required documents are collected
check.manual_rate.stop.detail: State the reason for departing from the calculation.
check.manual_rate.stop.title: Manual rate without a reason
check.manual_rate.warn.detail: The calculation gives {auto}, {applied} was entered. Reason: {reason}.
check.manual_rate.warn.title: The rate was entered manually
check.min_rate.ok.title: The minimum rate is met
check.min_rate.stop.title: The rate is below the minimum
check.multi_class.main.detail: The calculation runs on class {first}. Classes {others} are calculated separately: each part counts as a conditional contract (Regulation 1882, cl. 11).
check.multi_class.main.title: A product made of several parts
check.multi_class.mismatch.detail: Product {product} has classes {classes}, but the calculation was requested for class {class}.
check.multi_class.mismatch.title: The class does not belong to the product
check.multi_class.part.detail: Class {class} is being calculated. The main part of the product is class {first} and is calculated separately.
check.multi_class.part.title: A part of a multi-class product
check.no_franchise.warn.detail: Small losses fall entirely on the company.
check.no_franchise.warn.title: No deductible is set
check.premium_unpaid.warn.detail: Under art. 33¹ a policy binds the insurer in full even if the premium is unpaid.
check.premium_unpaid.warn.title: The premium has not been received
check.pricing_mode.negotiated.detail: No minimum rate is set for product {product}. The technical rate {gross} is a guide; the final rate is agreed with the head office.
check.pricing_mode.negotiated.title: Rate agreed with the head office
check.pricing_mode.program.detail: No minimum rate is set for product {product}. The technical rate {gross} is a guide; the final rate comes from the insurance programme.
check.pricing_mode.program.title: Rate under the insurance programme
check.pricing_mode.treaty.detail: No minimum rate is set for product {product}. The technical rate {gross} is a guide; the final rate comes from the master contract.
check.pricing_mode.treaty.title: Rate under the master contract
check.risk_limit_20.ok.detail: The cap is {limit} UZS as at {date}.
check.risk_limit_20.ok.title: The single-risk limit is met
check.risk_limit_20.stop.detail: The cap is {limit} UZS (Regulation 1806, cl. 15). Reinsurance is needed.
check.risk_limit_20.stop.title: The 20% single-risk limit is exceeded
check.risk_limit_20.unknown.detail: There is no data on the company's own funds and reserves.
check.risk_limit_20.unknown.title: The single-risk limit was not checked
check.statutory_rate.warn.detail: This is a compulsory class (product {product}). The rate comes from a regulation; the calculated rate is not a basis. The technical rate {gross} is only a guide. The statutory rate is not yet in the reference: check the rate against the act and do not issue the contract on the calculated figure.
check.statutory_rate.warn.title: The rate is set by a regulation
check.sum_ok.ok.detail: The payment will be in full.
check.sum_ok.ok.title: The sum insured equals the value
check.sum_over_value.stop.detail: The excess is {excess} UZS. Under Civil Code art. 938 the contract is void in that part.
check.sum_over_value.stop.title: The sum insured exceeds the insurable value
check.sum_vs_valuation.equal.detail: Valuation: {value} UZS. The final insurable value is agreed by the parties when the contract is made (Civil Code art. 935).
check.sum_vs_valuation.equal.title: The sum insured equals the valuation
check.sum_vs_valuation.over.detail: Valuation: {value} UZS, sum insured {sum} UZS — higher by {excess} UZS. In the part above the value the contract is invalid and the overpaid premium is not refunded (Civil Code arts. 934, 938).
check.sum_vs_valuation.over.title: The sum insured is above the valuation
check.sum_vs_valuation.under.detail: Valuation: {value} UZS, the sum insured is {share}% of it. On a loss the payment will be the same share of the damage (Civil Code art. 936); the client must be warned before signing (art. 63).
check.sum_vs_valuation.under.title: The sum insured is below the valuation
check.underinsurance.warn.detail: The sum is {share}% of the value. Under Civil Code art. 936 the payment falls by the same proportion.
check.underinsurance.warn.title: Underinsurance
check.value_agreed.warn.detail: The calculation states a value of {declared} UZS, the system's valuation is {value} UZS. The gap must be closed before the policy is issued: the value cannot be contested later (Civil Code arts. 932, 935).
check.value_agreed.warn.title: The value in the calculation differs from the valuation
